screens.name: app
screens.description: The shell once signed in: the bottom bar's sections (photos, files, shared, backup). Always shown after sign-in.

screens.name: files
screens.description: Your own folders, in the Files section. Reached by: app go_to files (it starts at the top level).

screens.name: shared
screens.description: A folder someone shared with you, in the same browser as files; its top is the shared folder. Reached by: app go_to shared, then shared_list open <share id of a folder>.

screens.name: notifications
screens.description: The bell in the top row (unread count) and its sheet: open, page, mark read, open an item (its subject in the Shared section: shared_nav, shared_list). Always shown after sign-in.

screens.name: signin
screens.description: The sign-in flow: the server address, then username and password (step: server / credentials / signed_in). The password is never in the state (passwordSet only). Reached by: a fresh install or after sign-out.

screens.name: files_nav
screens.description: The Files section's pages (browse, search): search opens document search, back closes it. Reached by: app go_to files.

screens.name: document_search
screens.description: Search of file names and PDF/text contents; snippets mark matches with **...**. Reached by: app go_to files, then files_nav search.

screens.name: uploads
screens.description: Uploads from this phone with their progress and errors (a do never waits for them: ls again). Reached by: any folder page (files or shared).

screens.name: shared_nav
screens.description: The Shared section's pages (list, folder, album, photo, friends): friends opens Friends from the list, back returns to the list. Reached by: app go_to shared.

screens.name: shared_list
screens.description: What others shared with you: open a folder (shows the shared browser), an album or a photo; leave a share. Reached by: app go_to shared.

screens.name: friends
screens.description: Your friends (a one-way list: they are not told): add by username or from suggestions (people you share with), remove. Friends without access show as one-tap picks in the Share sheet. Reached by: app go_to shared, then shared_nav friends.

screens.name: share
screens.description: The Share sheet of a folder, file, album or photo you own: share by username or with a friend's pick (share_with), change or stop a share, close. Reached by: tapping Share on something you own (a folder page's header or a row's actions, an album's header, the photo viewer); no LS-DO action opens it yet (scripts/lsdo ui shows the button).

screens.name: photos
screens.description: The Photos section's navigation: show timeline / albums / explore, open search, back. Reached by: app go_to photos.

screens.name: timeline
screens.description: Photos by month: page, open a photo, add photos to an album; also the filtered timeline opened from explore. Reached by: app go_to photos (the default), or explore open <id>.

screens.name: albums
screens.description: The album list: open, create. Reached by: app go_to photos, then photos show albums.

screens.name: album
screens.description: One album's page: its photos, rename, cover and removal (owner or write access). Reached by: albums open <id> or albums create <name>.

screens.name: explore
screens.description: People, places, tags and cameras: open a card (a filtered timeline), see all of a section. Reached by: app go_to photos, then photos show explore.

screens.name: photo_search
screens.description: Photo search: text, filter, order, open a result. Reached by: app go_to photos, then photos search.

screens.name: backup
screens.description: Backup status, progress, counts and failures: back up now, retry failures, open settings. Needs photo access (else only refresh). Reached by: app go_to backup.

screens.name: backup_settings
screens.description: Backup settings: the four toggles and this phone's name; back returns to backup. Reached by: backup open_settings.

screens.name: album_picker
screens.description: Which albums (iOS) or folders (Android) are backed up: open the sheet, toggle, select all. Reached by: app go_to backup (also on backup_settings).
